finalText:
**Big but shallow: 1082 hits across 94 files.**

Safe to rename: 75 service files plus [lib/audit.js](lib/audit.js). Local names only.

| Must not rename | Why |
|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | Public contract, frozen |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js#L8) WIRE values | Keys clients read |
| `migrations/` (12 files) | Applied history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` (4 files) | Generated, gets overwritten |

Also the SQL strings in every `repo/` file. The column stays `account_id`. A separate migration would be needed.
